narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The biggest number has six places, so it needs six clicks.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But six clicks would give each place only one click.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That makes one lakh, ten thousand, a thousand, a hundred, ten and one, which is not the number.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Each digit is the click count for its place.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Add the digits to get the fewest clicks.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Write the expression with each digit as the multiplier of its place value.

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip counts the places instead of adding the digits. Three six seven eight one three has six places, but the clicks come from the digits themselves.
